reason: Converge PentaRelease publication after PR-layer autonomy certification: integrate release navigation into the existing canonical PentaDocs tab without creating a ninth tab, and make generated PR retirement independent of unavailable branch-delete authority while preserving provider evidence and bot-identity proof.

changes.reason: Validate and manage the PentaRelease group inside the existing CrownThrive OS PentaDocs tab, enforce an eight-tab top-level ceiling, normalize the nested group before documentation governance, and preserve all comprehensive provider asset/readback requirements.

Retire provider-proven generated PR shells without requiring remote branch deletion. Preserve contents:read least privilege and treat retained generated branches as advisory after successful PR closure.

exclusions: No core release asset, manifest, release-note, provider-readback, or bot-identity requirement is weakened.
No ninth top-level PentaDocs tab is created.
Existing unmanaged PentaDocs groups and pages are preserved; a conflicting unmanaged PentaRelease group fails closed.
The reconciler keeps contents read-only and does not acquire branch-delete authority.
Generated PR closure remains mandatory for backlog retirement; branch retention cannot manufacture a release or merge.
No D3, credential, payout, provider-secret, release-bypass, or money-movement authority is added.
